turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I swap regular flour for whole wheat in my muffin recipe?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can, but start by swapping only half. Whole wheat makes muffins denser and a little drier.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I add more liquid then?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, a couple of extra spoonfuls of milk helps. Letting the batter rest ten minutes also softens the bran.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if I want to cut

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can cut about a quarter without problems. Mashed banana or a bit of applesauce adds sweetness back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Banana sounds good. I have some brown ones.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect, the browner the better for baking.
